# ISMIR 2002

> The official website for the 3rd International Conference on Music Information Retrieval, held at IRCAM/Centre Pompidou in Paris in 2002.

ISMIR 2002 was a premier conference bringing together researchers in music information retrieval from institutions worldwide including Indiana University, University of Waikato, and CNRS. The conference featured peer-reviewed papers, posters, panels, and tutorials on music retrieval technologies and methodologies.
